positions.title: Technical Lead Manager
positions.description:
My team owns developer experience for search and vector search.

* Improved developer experience, driving a 30% lift in activation by delivering IDE code completion and inline documentation from a single source of truth, reducing duplication and errors.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developer infrastructure at very large scale. 

* Technical Lead, Flutter, Android Platform. 
Direct impact: Grew platform to 1M MAU developers and over XXM in cloud and ads revenue.
* Built major components of the CLI, build system, embedding libraries, Android views, and test framework.
* Launched Google Ads integration enabling a new revenue stream and partnerships.
* Launched add to an existing app integration to accelerate adoption. Today, Flutter is #1 developer framework for building cross platform apps.

* Technical Lead, Google Search, Knowledge graph.
Java, C++, gRPC, distributed systems.
* Built the mini-app backend and API.
* Launched elections experience on search.
   
* Polymer, Web components, Frontend architecture.
Stack: TypeScript, Web.
* Built virtual scroller and DOM recycling libraries for the Chrome Web platform. This library freed the main thread, reduced jank and improved user experience. This effort was critical in unblocking major product launches across YouTube Web and Chrome.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: * Built data synchronization library for complex objects using early versions of CRDT while contributing a new native app for business owners. This library allowed the client to stay synced without polling as polling was prohibited.

positions.title: Creator
positions.description:
User Interface Component that make it easier to insert a page turning mechanism for HTML5 Content. It’s used by 500 fortune companies including Disney, NBC Universal, Microsoft and others.
• Reduced browser repainting and DOM nodes. This enhancement makes transitions look more fluent and accurate on 5th release.
• Designed an API for ebooks that allows HTML content to flow among div elements. The DOM traversal uses binary search to detect the breaking point.
• Foundation Events. A set of touch events such as tap, double tap and pinch that behave differently depending on the platform.
• Designed a selection text feature that uses a randomized-built K-D tree to search for the closest word to the user’s selection on a pdf page.
